text:
deploy-bot: release deploy 2026-03-19-rc5 blocked by prod healthcheck failures — automated env-parity check flagged mismatched nginx config and missing proxy auth secret in prod. holding promotion.

jin_lee: what's the exact mismatch? logs?

deploy-bot: parity-check output:
```
staging/nginx.conf: client_max_body_size 50M;
prod/nginx.conf:    client_max_body_size 1M;
staging/secrets/proxy-auth: present
prod/secrets/proxy-auth:    MISSING
``` 
failed healthcheck from prod-upstream: 413 Payload Too Large on multipart model asset upload test and 502 from upstream when proxy auth absent.

marta: ugh. that client_max_body_size explains the 413s we saw in canary yesterday. Why wasn't that caught earlier? :thinking: 

samira: infra-validate only checks presence/keys, not value parity for nginx. I'll add a rule but short-term we need a fix.

ops-oncall: timeline? can we hotfix prod nginx conf or roll back the release image? the release also contains a small change to multipart handler — pinning might be faster.

jin_lee: we should avoid changing prod nginx at night without a canary. safer to roll back rc5 to rc4 which worked in prod testing earlier.

marta: agreed. rollback looks low-risk. rc5 introduced image tag `inference-runtime:2026.03.19-rc5` — pin back to `2026.03.12-rc4` in releasebot.

release-manager: I'll coordinate the rollback. Samira, can you prepare a one-line patch to releasebot to pin the image and add a rollout freeze for 30m? I'll also open a quick PR to sync nginx conf values.

samira: preparing patch now. also creating a follow-up ticket to add numeric config parity checks for nginx/HAProxy in infra-validate.

infra-bot: releasebot patch queued: PR #7942 — pin image to 2026.03.12-rc4. Applying canary rollback plan.

ops-oncall: initiating rollback now. rolling back canary -> prod pin. watchers: @marta @jin_lee @samira

deploy-bot: rollback job started: job id 81234. expected completion ~3m. will post when done.

deploy-bot: rollback job completed successfully. prod back to inference-runtime:2026.03.12-rc4. healthchecks passing.

marta: nice. next steps: 1) add missing prod secret (proxy-auth) from staging copy after rotating creds, 2) sync client_max_body_size to 50M in prod nginx conf via configmap, 3) add infra-validate rule, 4) re-run release with rc5 after verification.

samira: creating secrets PR to add `proxy-auth` to prod keystore with vault path vault://prod/proxy-auth (will rotate creds in the process). PR #7943.

jin_lee: I'll own nginx configmap change. going to open PR to update configmap and add a small e2e for multipart upload to the release test suite.

release-manager: logging these actions in the release notes and the postmortem checklist. tagging the re-release window for tomorrow 10:00 UTC to avoid nighttime risk.

marta: thanks all. lessons: numeric config values can break behaviour drastically — infra-validate should treat some common server configs as typed fields, not free text. 

ops-oncall: noted. marking this thread resolved after PR merges and re-release verification.
